front: How to validate a forecasting competition?
back: Hold out the last period with the same length as the test, train on earlier data, repeat on a few windows.

front: Two meanings of leakage on Kaggle?
back: Your features use information not available at prediction time, or the data has an exploitable pattern like row order.

front: Where does a Kaggle notebook save output?
back: In /kaggle/working. Input data is read-only under /kaggle/input.
